title: Extract job handlers into gateway_jobs.go
description: Move all job-related handlers from gateway_handlers.go into a new gateway_jobs.go file. Functions to move: handleListJobs, handleGetJob, handleListJobDecisions, handleCancelJob, handleRemediateJob, handleSubmitJobHTTP, handleGetMemory, handlePutArtifact, handleGetArtifact, handleGetTrace (~lines 39-1260 covering workers/status, jobs, memory, artifacts, traces). Also move handleGetWorkers and handleStatus since they are job-domain (worker heartbeats). Include any private types/consts defined in that range that are only used by these handlers (e.g., artifactPutRequest, request structs). Keep package gateway. Keep imports minimal — only what these functions need.
